title: "until the end of your next turn" ends too early (26 cards)
body:
Encoded as `UntilPlayersNextTurn`, which ends when your next turn begins, so the card cannot be played during that turn:

Elemental Mascot; Embrace the Unknown; Evil's Thrall; Flameskull; Hex Magic; Ignite the Future; Inspired Tinkering; Invasion of Kaldheim; Light Up the Stage; Mjölnir's Might; Molly Hayes, Runaway; Monastery Raid; Practiced Scrollsmith; Reckless Impulse; Rooting Moloch; Season of the Bold; Seize Opportunity; Single Combat; The Madcap Jester; Thor, God of Thunder; Tlincalli Hunter; Wheel of Potential; Wrenn's Resolve

Encoded as `UntilEndOfTurn`: Atsushi, the Blazing Sky; Mazzy, Truesword Paladin; Ral and the Implicit Maze
